observations.statement: The preserved s05 log prints train_loss=0.0000 and train_acc=1.000 for the completed widths. Those are rounded logger strings, not full-precision residuals or exact train-error counts.
observations.scope: Display strings in the preserved log for the completed width rows.
observations.limitations: A printed accuracy of 1.000 does not prove that every training row was correct, and a printed loss of 0.0000 is not a measured zero residual.

observations.statement: On the completed validation rows, logged val_loss moves from 0.0063 at width 8 through 0.0020 at width 256 and is 0.0038 at width 512. Width 512 also has settled=False. This partial rounded validation series does not establish double descent: there is no completed later width showing a second decline, and the points are not a held-out test.
observations.scope: Rounded validation losses and settled flags printed for widths 8 through 512.
observations.limitations: No confidence interval is computed. Settled is the historical logger flag, not a re-derived convergence certificate. The rise at one width is not a measured right-hand descent.

observations.statement: The preserved log starts width 1024 and has no completed metric line after that start line.
observations.locator: line 18, final line of the snapshot
observations.limitations: Absence of a completion line does not identify why the run stopped and does not describe metrics that were never logged.

observations.statement: The frozen directory listing for result/05_dnn records no child files. This audit did not open checkpoint payloads because none were listed.
observations.scope: One-level names and sizes of result/05_dnn at the listing time.
observations.limitations: The listing does not search other directories and does not prove that a checkpoint was never written outside this path.

observations.statement: pca_info.json records final_dims 4096 under the rule variance_target_not_met_within_cap. The same file records explained variance 0.8628636002540588 at 256 components against a 0.95 target.
observations.limitations: The JSON does not by itself show that the reduced matrices contain 4096 columns. Those arrays were not hashed or opened.

observations.statement: The preserved partial_meta.json says dim 768, n_texts 464274, batch_size 32 and hash b84efb7dcf1eef7a. It does not contain backend or model keys.
observations.scope: Bytes of this one JSON object.
observations.limitations: The current writer also emits backend and model. This audit did not execute that writer and did not read partial.dat, so 768 is not a measured width of the array.

observations.statement: probe.json records model qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b, backend routerai and dim 4096. That dimension disagrees with partial_meta.json dim 768. The disagreement is between two small JSON files.
observations.limitations: A probe of text_chars 4 does not certify the width of train.npy. The array was not read.

observations.statement: The embedding cache key is computed from backend, model, batch size, text count, and SHA-256 prefixes of the first and last concatenated text. It does not hash every row or the internal order.
observations.scope: Static reading of the current cache-key call. The stage was not executed.
observations.limitations: Reading the key formula does not say whether the stored matrices match the current texts. A new key would not retroactively validate the old cache.

observations.statement: compute_hash returns the first 16 hexadecimal characters of a SHA-256 over the sorted key-value strings. The code comment says the formula is frozen because a live run wrote it into partial_meta.json.
observations.limitations: The helper was not executed against the historical texts in this audit.

observations.statement: The preserved stage cache file records hash 6135da08b14f8ae4.
observations.limitations: The file does not identify which rows produced the hash.

observations.statement: partial_meta.json hash b84efb7dcf1eef7a is not the hash recorded in cache_hash.json, 6135da08b14f8ae4. The partial metadata is therefore not the same record as the completed stage cache file.
observations.scope: Comparison of two preserved JSON strings.
observations.limitations: Neither string was recomputed from matrix bytes. The mismatch does not say which file, if either, matches train.npy.

observations.statement: The current resume predicate requires the partial hash, text count, backend, model, batch size and flag length to agree, and it raises if a matching partial dimension disagrees with the probe. This audit did not run that predicate.
observations.scope: Static reading of the current source.
observations.limitations: A static reading is not an execution on the historical partial files.

observations.statement: The late-acceleration summary records embedding_corpus not_read and task_type CPU. It is not an observation about the essay embedding corpus.
observations.scope: Fields in the preserved pilot summary.
observations.limitations: The summary was not recomputed by rerunning the pilot.

observations.statement: In the preserved summary, H1 is inconclusive for the synthetic and breast-cancer blocks, and H4 records border_count, depth and ensemble_size as not_observed. The summary itself says a coarse peak is not double descent.
observations.scope: Verdict strings stored in the summary for this pilot.
observations.limitations: These verdicts are the pilot's own labels. They are not a new hypothesis test and do not transfer to the essay corpus.

observations.statement: The 4 November review says the inputs are frozen EmbeddingGemma embeddings. The preserved probe names qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b. The two texts do not describe the same embedder.
observations.quote: В качестве входа используются замороженные эмбеддинги EmbeddingGemma.
observations.scope: One sentence of the historical review, contrasted with the preserved probe JSON.
observations.limitations: The review sentence is not a measurement of the matrix. The matrix bytes remain unread.

observations.statement: The 4 November protocol revision records that s03 uses qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b at 4096 dimensions through RouterAI, that the review discusses EmbeddingGemma, and that the embedder was not switched.
observations.quote: Ревью обсуждает EmbeddingGemma. Эмбеддер не переключён.
observations.limitations: This is a dated project note, not an independent remeasurement of the embeddings.

observations.statement: The preserved MLP log records Device: cpu and noise_regime=clean. That is the logged regime of this snapshot, not a description of every earlier plan.
observations.scope: The device line and the clean noise labels in this log.
observations.limitations: The log does not quote the older preregistration. A CPU/clean log does not audit a GPU or noisy arm that is not in the log.

observations.statement: source_manifest.json names the Hugging Face mirror andythetechnerd03/AI-human-text and says the processed mirror is not a byte copy of the Kaggle CSV. It records 487235 rows written.
observations.quote: Not a byte copy of the Kaggle CSV.
observations.limitations: The manifest's parquet hashes were not recomputed. Split membership, near-duplicate leakage and row order were not assessed.

prediction_assessments.reason: The attested small artifacts are a rounded incomplete validation log, an empty checkpoint listing, unhashed matrices, and a pilot that did not read the essay corpus. No coherent full-precision final result establishing double descent on that corpus was present in those files.
